title: Nobody tells you about Baltimore ground rent
source: swipe.md: top two outliers were 'what nobody tells you about [place]'; @MovingToMaryland ground rent warning

beats.say: Nobody tells you about Baltimore ground rent.
beats.shot: You climb the marble steps toward the phone and stop on the top step as you finish the line
beats.framing: Medium (waist up), head in the middle third, empty band above your head
beats.angle: Eye level, phone on tripod at the top of the steps

beats.say: You can own the rowhouse and not the land.
beats.screen: YOU OWN THE HOUSE. NOT THE LAND.
beats.shot: Say it to camera, then point straight down at the sidewalk on 'land'
beats.location: Sidewalk in front of the same house
beats.broll: Tilt from the roofline down the brick front to the sidewalk, 5 seconds, slow

beats.say: Somebody else owns the dirt. You pay them rent.
beats.shot: To camera, half a step closer than beat 2

beats.say: Usually it's small. Maybe {{$100}} a year.
beats.shot: To camera, street running away behind you
beats.angle: Eye level, turned 45 degrees from beat 3 so the background changes
beats.location: Same block, facing down the street

beats.say: But nobody mails you a reminder.
beats.shot: Voice only. Record the line to camera; the cutaway covers it
beats.broll: Close-up of the mail slot or mailbox, your hand opens it, it is empty. 4 seconds

beats.say: Skip it for years and it's a legal problem.
beats.shot: To camera, closest shot of the reel, slower delivery

beats.say: So before any offer, I ask one thing.
beats.shot: Walking along the block, phone held at arm's length or by a second person walking backward
beats.framing: Medium, you on the left third

beats.say: Is there a ground rent on this house?
beats.shot: Stop walking, turn square to camera, say it flat
beats.location: In front of a different house on the block

beats.say: Maryland has a public registry. Two minutes.
beats.shot: Voice only over a screen recording
beats.broll: Phone screen recording: open the Maryland SDAT real property search, type an address, scroll to the ground rent line. 6 seconds. Use a house you are allowed to show

beats.say: And a lot of them, you can buy out.
beats.shot: To camera, back at the steps
beats.angle: Slightly low (phone at chest height tilted up) so the house rises behind you

beats.say: Comment GROUND and I'll send you how to check.
beats.shot: To camera, point down toward the comments on 'comment'

beats.say: That's ground rent. Now somebody told you.
beats.shot: Say it, then turn and walk down the steps out of frame
